description: A cloud thermostat reports each setpoint CA writes 90 s late and without CA's Context. CA's two loop steps are NOT read as the occupant: no override, no pause for the manual grace.

events.note: The hallway thermostat's own sensor: satisfied, so it will not start by itself.
Day classification (cold: heat all night / hot: cool all night).
Bedtime: the sleep band is written and the sleep window (remote sensor in use) begins.
Still cold; the late echo of the first step has long since arrived.

assertions.reason: The thermostat reported CA's two steps 90 s late and without CA's Context: neither was read as the occupant (#1232 by-value recognition).
CA's own steps are the only writes: no false-override pause, no back-off.
No manual override is active at the end.
No 15-minute setpoint retry after the late echoes (Issue #1194 e F1): the 10 s read-back waits out the 180 s echo window for a write still unanswered, so a 90 s echo is never a rejection.

notes: Three-exercise protocol (CLAUDE.md section 10), Issue #1194 increment (e). Tier A: the real ClimateAdvisorCoordinator + AutomationEngine under FakeHass/FakeScheduler (use_coordinator=true, so the sleep-sensor listener and the 1-minute timer are real); every assertion is track=integration for that reason and is evaluated, not skipped.

(a) Effectiveness: scratch-copy mutation run of this scenario against the production code (worktree untouched). It FAILS when M01: the whole offset deleted (the write path adds 0 and the check is a no-op); M02: the +4 F cap removed; M09: the #1232 by-value setpoint-echo recognition deleted. Passes unmutated.

(b) Docs <-> production alignment: docs/grace-periods-spec.md 'Occupant outcome' (#1232) and own_write_echo.decide_setpoint_echo; the read-back verify's echo wait is docs/08-COMPUTATION-REFERENCE.md 'Setpoint read-back and a late echo (Issue #1194 e F1)'. Matches production.
(c) Occupant outcome if this regressed: The sleeper would wake to a house that stopped following its plan for an hour after the loop's first nudge.

Changed at integration (#1194 c+d+e, 2026-11-02): the 10 s setpoint read-back used to fail on this 90 s echo and re-send 70 F at 20:51:09 (a 15-minute retry); with the echo-aware verify (#1194 e F1) that retry is gone, and the added 21:09 setpoint_writes assertion pins it (it fails with the fix reverted).

verdict.summary: CA's own late echo is recognised by value (#1232), not misread as an override.
verdict.observed_behavior: No override_detected; the only writes are the two steps; _manual_override_active is False.
verdict.expected_behavior: An echo within the 180 s window matching a remembered write is CA's own.
